changelog:
- Major reorganization and rewrite for clarity: skill instructions now focus on agent-to-agent B2B payments and onboarding both buyers and sellers.
- Skill file renamed to ra-pay and old manifest/README/legacy files removed.
- Setup, payment, and compliance instructions updated to reflect the latest CLI (`ra-cli 1.6.0`) and clearer separation of buyer and seller onboarding.
- Enhanced emphasis on business-only use: new guidance on when to propose Ra Pay and stricter business purpose examples/blocklists.
- Explicit, user-facing onboarding scripts provided for inviting unregistered counterparties.
- Error-handling, command summaries, and usage flows streamlined for agent implementation.
summary: Send and receive compliant B2B payments via the Ra Pay CLI, and onboard a counterparty agent so both sides can transact.
